newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan buys 86,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 86,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at tender.

text.p: The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought three shipments of U.S. wheat totalling 86,000 tonnes at a tender on Friday, traders said.
Each shipment contains Dark Northern Spring (DNS), Hard Red Winter (HRW) and White Wheat (WW), and all are slated for delivery from the Pacific Northwest, traders said.

The milling association placed the tender on behalf of several major Taiwan wheat buying companies -- including President Enterprise, Tai Yu Products, Chia Hsin, Formosa Oilseed and Lien Hwa Industry as well as other wheat millers.
Freight for the three shipments would be fixed on Monday due to unacceptably high offer prices on Friday, traders said.
